title: Three Thousand Years of Xi County
synopsis: Throughout China's long history, place names often change. But there is one place in Henan that has kept the same name for three millenia. Find out the story of the peerless beauty who lent the county her name.

fullText.simplified:
三千年不改名的息县

    中国历史上，地名常常会改变。但河南有一座城市三千年来一直没有改名，一直叫“息县”。它与春秋时期一位美丽的女子——息夫人有关。
    息夫人是陈国国君的小女儿，长得非常漂亮。因为她的美貌，人们称她为“桃花夫人”。后来，她嫁给了息国的国君息侯，所以被称为“息夫人”。
    有一次，息夫人回家乡看望家人，路过姐姐家。姐夫蔡哀侯听说过她的美貌，见到她后非常喜欢。他不听妻子的话，一定要留下息夫人。幸好有姐姐的帮助，息夫人才回到息国。
    回国后，息夫人把事情告诉了丈夫。息侯很生气，但息国的力量比不上蔡国。于是，他想出了一个办法：让当时很强的楚国假装打息国，息侯向蔡国求救。等蔡国来帮忙时，楚国就可以趁机打蔡国。这个计划成功了。
    蔡哀侯被抓后，为了报复，他经常在楚国国王楚文王面前夸息夫人的美貌。楚文王听了以后，也对息夫人产生了兴趣。不久，楚文王打败了息国。为了救丈夫和百姓，息夫人只好嫁给了楚文王。
    息夫人进了楚国王宫后一直很伤心，不愿意和楚文王说话。后来，息夫人为楚文王生了两个儿子，她的小儿子成为了楚国的国王，即楚成王。在息夫人的帮助下，楚成王开始治理国家。
    像息夫人这样的绝世美人，在乱世中，根本无法左右自己的命运。虽然她的美貌可以迷倒三位君王，为她倾城亡国，但她不是害人的女子。相反，她为了百姓牺牲了自己的幸福，还帮助儿子管理国家，让楚国变得更强大。
    直到今天，息县依然保留着这个名字，人们在那里建了庙来纪念这位美丽又善良的女子。
fullText.traditional:
三千年不改名的息縣

    中國歷史上，地名常常會改變。但河南有一座城市三千年來一直沒有改名，一直叫“息縣”。它與春秋時期一位美麗的女子——息夫人有關。
    息夫人是陳國國君的小女兒，長得非常漂亮。因為她的美貌，人們稱她為“桃花夫人”。後來，她嫁給了息國的國君息侯，所以被稱為“息夫人”。
    有一次，息夫人回家鄉看望家人，路過姐姐家。姐夫蔡哀侯聽說過她的美貌，見到她後非常喜歡。他不聽妻子的話，一定要留下息夫人。幸好有姐姐的幫助，息夫人才回到息國。
    回國後，息夫人把事情告訴了丈夫。息侯很生氣，但息國的力量比不上蔡國。於是，他想出了一個辦法：讓當時很強的楚國假裝打息國，息侯向蔡國求救。等蔡國來幫忙時，楚國就可以趁機打蔡國。這個計劃成功了。
    蔡哀侯被抓後，為了報復，他經常在楚國國王楚文王面前誇息夫人的美貌。楚文王聽了以後，也對息夫人產生了興趣。不久，楚文王打敗了息國。為了救丈夫和百姓，息夫人只好嫁給了楚文王。
    息夫人進了楚國王宮後一直很傷心，不願意和楚文王說話。後來，息夫人為楚文王生了兩個兒子，她的小兒子成為了楚國的國王，即楚成王。在息夫人的幫助下，楚成王開始治理國家。
    像息夫人這樣的絕世美人，在亂世中，根本無法左右自己的命運。雖然她的美貌可以迷倒三位君王，為她傾城亡國，但她不是害人的女子。相反，她為了百姓犧牲了自己的幸福，還幫助兒子管理國家，讓楚國變得更強大。
    直到今天，息縣依然保留著這個名字，人們在那裡建了廟來紀念這位美麗又善良的女子。

sentences.simplified: 中国历史上，地名常常会改变。
sentences.traditional: 中國歷史上，地名常常會改變。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó lì shǐ shang dì míng cháng cháng huì gǎi biàn
sentences.english: In Chinese history, place names often change.

sentences.simplified: 但河南有一座城市三千年来一直没有改名，一直叫“息县”。
sentences.traditional: 但河南有一座城市三千年來一直沒有改名，一直叫“息縣”。
sentences.pinyin: dàn hé nán yǒu yí zuò chéng shì sān qiān nián lái yì zhí méi yǒu gǎi míng yì zhí jiào xī xiàn
sentences.english: However, there is a city in Henan that has not changed its name for three thousand years and has always been called “Xi County”.

sentences.simplified: 它与春秋时期一位美丽的女子——息夫人有关。
sentences.traditional: 它與春秋時期一位美麗的女子——息夫人有關。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǔ chūn qiū shí qī yí wèi měi lì de nǚ zǐ xī fū rén yǒu guān
sentences.english: It is related to a beautiful woman from the Spring and Autumn period—Lady Xi.

sentences.simplified: 息夫人是陈国国君的小女儿，长得非常漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 息夫人是陳國國君的小女兒，長得非常漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: xī fū rén shì chén guó guó jūn de xiǎo nǚ ér zhǎng de fēi cháng piào liang
sentences.english: Lady Xi was the youngest daughter of the king of the state of Chen and was very beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 因为她的美貌，人们称她为“桃花夫人”。
sentences.traditional: 因為她的美貌，人們稱她為“桃花夫人”。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā de měi mào rén men chēng tā wéi táo huā fū rén
sentences.english: Because of her beauty, people called her “Lady Peach Blossom”.

sentences.simplified: 后来，她嫁给了息国的国君息侯，所以被称为“息夫人”。
sentences.traditional: 後來，她嫁給了息國的國君息侯，所以被稱為“息夫人”。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái tā jià gěi le xī guó de guó jūn xī hóu suǒ yǐ bèi chēng wéi xī fū rén
sentences.english: Later, she married the ruler of the state of Xi, the Marquis of Xi, and thus was called “Lady Xi”.

sentences.simplified: 有一次，息夫人回家乡看望家人，路过姐姐家。
sentences.traditional: 有一次，息夫人回家鄉看望家人，路過姐姐家。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yí cì xī fū rén huí jiā xiāng kàn wàng jiā rén lù guò jiě jie jiā
sentences.english: Once, Lady Xi returned to her hometown to visit her family and passed by her older sister’s house.

sentences.simplified: 姐夫蔡哀侯听说过她的美貌，见到她后非常喜欢。
sentences.traditional: 姐夫蔡哀侯聽說過她的美貌，見到她後非常喜歡。
sentences.pinyin: jiě fu cài āi hóu tīng shuō guò tā de měi mào jiàn dào tā hòu fēi cháng xǐ huan
sentences.english: Her brother-in-law, Marquis Ai of Cai, had heard about her beauty and liked her very much after seeing her.

sentences.simplified: 他不听妻子的话，一定要留下息夫人。
sentences.traditional: 他不聽妻子的話，一定要留下息夫人。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù tīng qī zi de huà yí dìng yào liú xià xī fū rén
sentences.english: He didn’t listen to what his wife said and insisted on keeping Lady Xi there.

sentences.simplified: 幸好有姐姐的帮助，息夫人才回到息国。
sentences.traditional: 幸好有姐姐的幫助，息夫人才回到息國。
sentences.pinyin: xìng hǎo yǒu jiě jie de bāng zhù xī fū rén cái huí dào xī guó
sentences.english: Fortunately, with the help of her older sister, Lady Xi was able to return to the state of Xi.

sentences.simplified: 回国后，息夫人把事情告诉了丈夫。
sentences.traditional: 回國後，息夫人把事情告訴了丈夫。
sentences.pinyin: huí guó hòu xī fū rén bǎ shì qing gào su le zhàng fu
sentences.english: After returning to her own country, Lady Xi told her husband about the matter.

sentences.simplified: 息侯很生气，但息国的力量比不上蔡国。
sentences.traditional: 息侯很生氣，但息國的力量比不上蔡國。
sentences.pinyin: xī hóu hěn shēng qì dàn xī guó de lì liang bǐ bú shàng cài guó
sentences.english: The Marquis of Xi was very angry, but the power of the state of Xi could not match that of the state of Cai.

sentences.simplified: 于是，他想出了一个办法：让当时很强的楚国假装打息国，
sentences.traditional: 於是，他想出了一個辦法：讓當時很強的楚國假裝打息國，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā xiǎng chū le yí ge bàn fǎ ràng dāng shí hěn qiáng de chǔ guó jiǎ zhuāng dǎ xī guó
sentences.english: Therefore, he came up with a plan: have the state of Chu, which was very powerful at the time, pretend to attack the state of Xi.

sentences.simplified: 息侯向蔡国求救。
sentences.traditional: 息侯向蔡國求救。
sentences.pinyin: xī hóu xiàng cài guó qiú jiù
sentences.english: Then, the Marquis of Xi would seek help from the state of Cai.

sentences.simplified: 等蔡国来帮忙时，楚国就可以趁机打蔡国。
sentences.traditional: 等蔡國來幫忙時，楚國就可以趁機打蔡國。
sentences.pinyin: děng cài guó lái bāng máng shí chǔ guó jiù kě yǐ chèn jī dǎ cài guó
sentences.english: When the state of Cai came to help, the state of Chu could take the opportunity to attack the state of Cai.

sentences.simplified: 这个计划成功了。
sentences.traditional: 這個計劃成功了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge jì huà chéng gōng le
sentences.english: This plan succeeded.

sentences.simplified: 蔡哀侯被抓后，为了报复，他经常在楚国国王楚文王面前夸息夫人的美貌。
sentences.traditional: 蔡哀侯被抓後，為了報復，他經常在楚國國王楚文王面前誇息夫人的美貌。
sentences.pinyin: cài āi hóu bèi zhuā hòu wèi le bào fù tā jīng cháng zài chǔ guó guó wáng chǔ wén wáng miàn qián kuā xī fū rén de měi mào
sentences.english: After Marquis Ai of Cai was captured, in order to take revenge, he often praised the beauty of Lady Xi in front of King Wen of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 楚文王听了以后，也对息夫人产生了兴趣。不久，楚文王打败了息国。
sentences.traditional: 楚文王聽了以後，也對息夫人產生了興趣。不久，楚文王打敗了息國。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ wén wáng tīng le yǐ hòu yě duì xī fū rén chǎn shēng le xìng qù bù jiǔ chǔ wén wáng dǎ bài le xī guó
sentences.english: After hearing this, King Wen of Chu also became interested in Lady Xi. Soon, King Wen of Chu defeated the state of Xi.

sentences.simplified: 为了救丈夫和百姓，息夫人只好嫁给了楚文王。
sentences.traditional: 為了救丈夫和百姓，息夫人只好嫁給了楚文王。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le jiù zhàng fu hé bǎi xìng xī fū rén zhǐ hǎo jià gěi le chǔ wén wáng
sentences.english: In order to save her husband and the people, Lady Xi had no choice but to marry King Wen of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 息夫人进了楚国王宫后一直很伤心，不愿意和楚文王说话。
sentences.traditional: 息夫人進了楚國王宮後一直很傷心，不願意和楚文王說話。
sentences.pinyin: xī fū rén jìn le chǔ guó wáng gōng hòu yì zhí hěn shāng xīn bú yuàn yì hé chǔ wén wáng shuō huà
sentences.english: After Lady Xi entered the palace of the state of Chu, she was always very sad and unwilling to speak with King Wen of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 后来，息夫人为楚文王生了两个儿子，她的小儿子成为了楚国的国王，即楚成王。
sentences.traditional: 後來，息夫人為楚文王生了兩個兒子，她的小兒子成為了楚國的國王，即楚成王。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái xī fū rén wèi chǔ wén wáng shēng le liǎng ge ér zi tā de xiǎo ér zi chéng wéi le chǔ guó de guó wáng jí chǔ chéng wáng
sentences.english: Later, Lady Xi bore two sons for King Wen of Chu. Her youngest son became the king of the state of Chu, known as King Cheng of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 在息夫人的帮助下，楚成王开始治理国家。
sentences.traditional: 在息夫人的幫助下，楚成王開始治理國家。
sentences.pinyin: zài xī fū rén de bāng zhù xià chǔ chéng wáng kāi shǐ zhì lǐ guó jiā
sentences.english: With the help of Lady Xi, King Cheng of Chu began to govern the country.

sentences.simplified: 像息夫人这样的绝世美人，在乱世中，根本无法左右自己的命运。
sentences.traditional: 像息夫人這樣的絕世美人，在亂世中，根本無法左右自己的命運。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng xī fū rén zhè yàng de jué shì měi rén zài luàn shì zhōng gēn běn wú fǎ zuǒ yòu zì jǐ de mìng yùn
sentences.english: A peerless beauty like Lady Xi, in times of chaos, was completely unable to control her own fate.

sentences.simplified: 虽然她的美貌可以迷倒三位君王，为她倾城亡国，
sentences.traditional: 雖然她的美貌可以迷倒三位君王，為她傾城亡國，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā de měi mào kě yǐ mí dào sān wèi jūn wáng wèi tā qīng chéng wáng guó
sentences.english: Although her beauty could captivate three kings and lead to the downfall of cities and nations, ..

sentences.simplified: 但她不是害人的女子。
sentences.traditional: 但她不是害人的女子。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā bú shì hài rén de nǚ zǐ
sentences.english: .. she was not a woman who brought harm to others.

sentences.simplified: 相反，她为了百姓牺牲了自己的幸福，还帮助儿子管理国家，让楚国变得更强大。
sentences.traditional: 相反，她為了百姓犧牲了自己的幸福，還幫助兒子管理國家，讓楚國變得更強大。
sentences.pinyin: xiāng fǎn tā wèi le bǎi xìng xī shēng le zì jǐ de xìng fú hái bāng zhù ér zi guǎn lǐ guó jiā ràng chǔ guó biàn de gèng qiáng dà
sentences.english: On the contrary, she sacrificed her own happiness for the people and helped her son govern the country, making the state of Chu stronger.

sentences.simplified: 直到今天，息县依然保留着这个名字，人们在那里建了庙来纪念这位美丽又善良的女子。
sentences.traditional: 直到今天，息縣依然保留著這個名字，人們在那裡建了廟來紀念這位美麗又善良的女子。
sentences.pinyin: zhí dào jīn tiān xī xiàn yī rán bǎo liú zhe zhè ge míng zi rén men zài nà lǐ jiàn le miào lái jì niàn zhè wèi měi lì yòu shàn liáng de nǚ zǐ
sentences.english: To this day, Xi County still retains this name, and people have built a temple there to commemorate this beautiful and kind woman.

sentence_translations: Xi County Has Not Changed Its Name for Three Thousand Years
In Chinese history, place names often change.
However, there is a city in Henan that has not changed its name for three thousand years and has always been called “Xi County”.
It is related to a beautiful woman from the Spring and Autumn period—Lady Xi.
Lady Xi was the youngest daughter of the king of the state of Chen and was very beautiful.
Because of her beauty, people called her “Lady Peach Blossom”.
Later, she married the ruler of the state of Xi, the Marquis of Xi, and thus was called “Lady Xi”.
Once, Lady Xi returned to her hometown to visit her family and passed by her older sister’s house.
Her brother-in-law, Marquis Ai of Cai, had heard about her beauty and liked her very much after seeing her.
He didn’t listen to what his wife said and insisted on keeping Lady Xi there.
Fortunately, with the help of her older sister, Lady Xi was able to return to the state of Xi.
After returning to her own country, Lady Xi told her husband about the matter.
The Marquis of Xi was very angry, but the power of the state of Xi could not match that of the state of Cai.
Therefore, he came up with a plan: have the state of Chu, which was very powerful at the time, pretend to attack the state of Xi.
Then, the Marquis of Xi would seek help from the state of Cai.
When the state of Cai came to help, the state of Chu could take the opportunity to attack the state of Cai.
This plan succeeded.
After Marquis Ai of Cai was captured, in order to take revenge, he often praised the beauty of Lady Xi in front of King Wen of Chu.
After hearing this, King Wen of Chu also became interested in Lady Xi. Soon, King Wen of Chu defeated the state of Xi.
In order to save her husband and the people, Lady Xi had no choice but to marry King Wen of Chu.
After Lady Xi entered the palace of the state of Chu, she was always very sad and unwilling to speak with King Wen of Chu.
Later, Lady Xi bore two sons for King Wen of Chu. Her youngest son became the king of the state of Chu, known as King Cheng of Chu.
With the help of Lady Xi, King Cheng of Chu began to govern the country.
A peerless beauty like Lady Xi, in times of chaos, was completely unable to control her own fate.
Although her beauty could captivate three kings and lead to the downfall of cities and nations, ..
.. she was not a woman who brought harm to others.
On the contrary, she sacrificed her own happiness for the people and helped her son govern the country, making the state of Chu stronger.
To this day, Xi County still retains this name, and people have built a temple there to commemorate this beautiful and kind woman.
